_doc: Per-repo overrides for the merge-queue skill. Precedence: built-in defaults < "*" < "owner/*" < "owner/repo" < flags given when invoking. Any key from DEFAULTS in scripts/mq.py can be set. Keys: author (me|all|[logins]), copilot (auto|required|off), update (rebase|merge|none), method (squash|merge|rebase), base, exclude_labels, exclude_title_patterns, release {branches, labels, titles}, addressing_bots, wait_timeout_minutes.
